date_policy: Dates distinguish signature, receipt, publication, effectiveness, registration and observation. Slash intervals do not imply a continuous negotiation or statutory processing clock.
classification_policy: A policy/administrative/corporate observation is not automatically a bilateral bargaining move. Private authority, motives and requests remain unknown unless evidenced.
